_comment: Film 63 Lyria 3.5 prompts (google/lyria-3.5, 0.10 USD per track, 6 tracks, 2026-11-24). Method as Film 66: one track per chapter; chapters = sections of timing.json (H,1 | 2,3 | 4,M | 5,6 | 7,8 | 9,A2 + end screen). Files in /tmp/claude-0/f63/audio/music, not in the repo. Prompt sent = style + ' A <len> track. ' + mood.
style: Instrumental underscore for a calm, serious editorial documentary about a Pope's letter on artificial intelligence. Mystical and still: the inside of a vast dark stone basilica at night, candlelight, cool air, long reverberation. Deep sustained drones, slow evolving warm pads, sparse felt piano notes with long decay, soft glass harmonica and bowed crystal-glass tones, a distant wordless choir pad that only breathes in and out like an organ stop far away. A sacred undertone, but no hymn, no chant melody, no recognizable liturgical or church melody, no church organ tune, no bells melody. No drums, no percussion, no beat, no lyrics, no words, no solo voice. Not uplifting, not triumphant, not epic, not cinematic trailer, not new age kitsch. Very quiet, narrow dynamic range, slow, made to sit under a speaking voice.

M0.chapter: H, 1 (artificial intelligence will not save you, the promise, disarmed C1, the encyclical, a purely technical form of salvation)
M0.mood: grave and mysterious from the first second: a low drone and a cold glass tone, single piano notes falling into reverberation, a faint distant choir breath; something old meets something new; steady, no build-up, no resolution

M1.chapter: 2, 3 (the labs' strongest argument: a country of geniuses, the scale; the catch: how the promise sees you)
M1.mood: a little warmer and more open but still uneasy: glassy shimmering pads, slow piano intervals, a soft pulse of bowed crystal tones; the seduction of a great promise and the quiet doubt underneath it

M2.chapter: 4, M (Babel: tower or wall, the new monopolies, goods meant for everyone; subscribe call)
M2.mood: darker and heavier: a deep low drone like stone and wind inside a tower, slow sustained low strings and pads, sparse low piano, a restrained tension without drama; power gathered in few hands

M3.chapter: 5, 6 (work and dignity, the industrial revolution, labor share; a lab on the stage of the Vatican, pressures, grown not built)
M3.mood: contemplative and human: warm felt piano with long silences between phrases, soft glass harmonica, a slow warm drone, a faint wordless choir pad in the background; the dignity of work, a builder of the machines standing in an old hall; patient and serious throughout

M4.chapter: 7, 8 (the Pope's answer: tools not persons, limits, freedom and an inner life C5; counter-voices, the poll, the verdict)
M4.mood: inward and luminous but not hopeful: very slow pads that open like light through a high window, soft crystal-glass tones, sparse piano, the distant choir breath a little closer; an inner life no machine reaches; calm, intimate, unresolved

M5.chapter: 9, A2 + end screen (both sides of the scale, a relationship that liberates, what you would keep, closing call, 15 s end screen)
M5.mood: quiet and grounded: the low drone and cold glass tone of the beginning return, now warmer, single piano notes, a soft choir pad; reflective and still, not triumphant; ends on one long, slowly decaying open chord into silence
